query.text: 旅行助手，请陪我一起游览，在我询问景点历史或建筑信息时为我解答。
query.text_en: Travel assistant, please tour with me and answer my questions when I ask about the history of attractions or architectural information.

annotation.text_zh: 请提供更多细节，我再为你查阅并确认年代。
annotation.text_en: Please provide more details, and I will look them up to confirm the period.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
